title: Wright Field engineers and strange hieroglyph-marked material

tellings.quote: people at places like Wright Airfield, which was responsible for recreating the German pulse jet engine in 1943, are talking about material they've never seen before with weird hieroglyphics

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that during and just after the Second World War, from 1943 to 1947, people at Wright Field, a US military airfield in Ohio, talked about material they had never seen before, marked with strange symbols like hieroglyphics. He notes that these were skilled people: in 1943 the same airfield had rebuilt a captured German pulse jet, an early type of jet engine. If true, it would mean experts who knew foreign technology well were handling something they could not place, even before the famous 1947 Roswell story.
